description.zh: 未发现 PCI 10ee:7022
description.en: PCI device 10ee:7022 was not found.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查PCI枚举、板卡供电和连接；仅lspci无法区分断电、接触不良或设备故障。
troubleshooting.en: Check PCI enumeration, board power and connections; lspci alone cannot identify the underlying cause.

description.zh: 初始化、内存分配或电机上电失败
description.en: Hardware initialization, allocation or motor power-on failed.

troubleshooting.zh: 查看硬件节点首个初始化错误，并核对PCI设备及运行权限；不要反复上电试错。
troubleshooting.en: Read the first hardware initialization error and check the PCI device and process permissions; avoid repeated power cycling.

description.zh: 硬件进程的诊断输入中断
description.en: Hardware diagnostic input has stopped.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查硬件节点是否存在及diagnostic_input发布频率，再查看退出或阻塞日志。
troubleshooting.en: Check that the hardware node exists and diagnostic_input is being published, then inspect exit or blocking logs.

description.zh: robot_reset 服务不存在
description.en: The robot_reset service is unavailable.

troubleshooting.zh: 核对硬件节点和robot_reset服务名称；若修改topic_prefix，检查两端前缀是否一致。
troubleshooting.en: Check the hardware node and robot_reset service name; if topic_prefix changed, verify both sides use the same prefix.

description.zh: 未识别的底层故障，保留原文
description.en: The hardware reported an unrecognized fault.

troubleshooting.zh: 按source定位原始来源，查看robot_diagnose和硬件日志中的原文，不猜测未知错误含义。
troubleshooting.en: Use source to locate the origin and read the original robot_diagnose and hardware logs; do not guess the fault meaning.

description.zh: 某个已启用电机反馈超时
description.en: An enabled motor has not provided feedback in time.

troubleshooting.zh: 按source定位关节，检查电机供电、CAN连接与反馈；不要通过屏蔽超时掩盖故障。
troubleshooting.en: Locate the joint using source and check motor power, CAN wiring and feedback; do not mask the timeout.

description.zh: 底层原有的 1 秒指令超时
description.en: The existing one-second motor command timeout was reached.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查example是否运行及actuators_cmds是否持续发布，核对控制线程异常日志。
troubleshooting.en: Check that example is running and continuously publishing actuators_cmds, and inspect control-thread errors.

description.zh: 位置超限位
description.en: Joint position exceeded its configured limit.

troubleshooting.zh: 先确保机械安全，核对source关节的实际姿态、零位、反馈和配置限位；排除原因前不要强制复位。
troubleshooting.en: Secure the mechanism first, then check the affected joint pose, zero calibration, feedback and configured limits; do not force a reset before resolving the cause.

description.zh: 速度超限
description.en: Joint velocity exceeded its configured limit.

troubleshooting.zh: 核对关节反馈速度、目标变化和配置上限，检查反馈是否跳变。
troubleshooting.en: Check joint feedback velocity, target changes and the configured limit, including discontinuities in feedback.

description.zh: 超扭矩
description.en: Joint torque exceeded its configured limit.

troubleshooting.zh: 先确保机械安全，检查关节负载、卡滞、接触和力矩反馈，再核对已有上限。
troubleshooting.en: Secure the mechanism first and check joint load, obstruction, contact and torque feedback, then review the existing limit.

description.zh: 进入底层安全模式
description.en: A motor entered the existing safe mode.

troubleshooting.zh: 查看该关节在进入安全模式前的首个错误及指令中断情况，确认原因后按既有流程处理。
troubleshooting.en: Inspect the first preceding joint fault and any command interruption, then follow the existing recovery procedure after resolving the cause.

description.zh: 底层错误锁存
description.en: A hardware or motor protection error remains latched.

troubleshooting.zh: 查看锁存前的故障记录并排除原因；故障不再出现不等于锁存已解除。
troubleshooting.en: Inspect the fault history before latching and resolve its cause; absence of new faults does not mean the latch has cleared.

description.zh: 电机原始错误码非零
description.en: The motor reported a nonzero raw error code.

troubleshooting.zh: 在robot_diagnose日志中读取该source的原始Error Code，按对应电机厂商协议排查；不要把事件码当成电机原始码。
troubleshooting.en: Read the raw Error Code for this source in robot_diagnose logs and consult the matching motor protocol; the event code is not the raw motor code.

description.zh: 电机回传欠压
description.en: The motor reported undervoltage.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查电机电源、电缆及带载压降，结合电机原始日志确认；不新增电压阈值。
troubleshooting.en: Check motor power, cabling and voltage drop under load against the original motor logs; no new voltage threshold is implied.

description.zh: 电机回传过压
description.en: The motor reported overvoltage.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查电源输出及回馈工况，结合驱动器额定参数和原始故障日志排查。
troubleshooting.en: Check power-supply output and regenerative operation against driver ratings and original fault logs.

description.zh: 电机回传编码器错误
description.en: The motor reported an encoder fault.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查该关节编码器反馈、连接和驱动器原始码；重新标定前先排除硬件问题。
troubleshooting.en: Check encoder feedback, connections and the raw driver code for this joint; resolve hardware issues before recalibration.

description.zh: 电机回传超速
description.en: The motor reported overspeed.

troubleshooting.zh: 核对实际速度、目标指令和驱动器原始错误，检查反馈跳变或机械异常。
troubleshooting.en: Check actual velocity, target commands and the raw driver error, including feedback discontinuities or mechanical problems.

description.zh: 电机进入错误状态
description.en: The motor reported an error state.

troubleshooting.zh: 查看对应关节驱动器原始状态和故障码，结合反馈及供电判断，不推测未公开状态位。
troubleshooting.en: Read the joint driver's raw state and fault code together with feedback and power status; do not infer undocumented bits.

description.zh: motor_cmd_trans 失败
description.en: motor_cmd_trans failed while preparing a motor command.

troubleshooting.zh: 查看对应关节的底层日志，核对关节名称、命令数据和既有转换参数。
troubleshooting.en: Inspect the joint's low-level logs and verify joint names, command data and existing conversion parameters.

description.zh: 反馈为空、重名、数组不匹配或非有限数
description.en: Motor feedback is empty, duplicated, mismatched or non-finite.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查反馈name与position/velocity/effort长度、重名及NaN/Inf，定位异常发布端。
troubleshooting.en: Check name and position/velocity/effort lengths, duplicate names and NaN/Inf values, then locate the faulty publisher.

description.zh: 指令格式异常、非有限数或负增益
description.en: Motor commands contain invalid data or negative gains.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查actuators_name与各命令数组长度、重名、NaN/Inf及负kp/kd，定位命令生成位置。
troubleshooting.en: Check actuators_name and command-array lengths, duplicate names, NaN/Inf and negative kp/kd, then locate the command producer.

description.zh: 反馈话题中断
description.en: The actuator feedback topic has stopped.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查actuator_states发布节点、QoS和硬件日志，区分整个话题中断与单关节反馈超时。
troubleshooting.en: Check the actuator_states publisher, QoS and hardware logs; distinguish a stopped topic from a single-joint timeout.

description.zh: example 指令流中断
description.en: The example actuator command stream has stopped.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查example启动和控制线程状态、topic前缀与actuators_cmds发布频率。
troubleshooting.en: Check example startup, control-thread status, topic prefixes and the actuators_cmds publication rate.

description.zh: 反馈时间戳缺失、倒退、过期或超前
description.en: Feedback timestamps are missing, reversed, stale or in the future.

troubleshooting.zh: 核对反馈header.stamp、发布端时钟和use_sim_time，检查两端时间源及同步。
troubleshooting.en: Check feedback header.stamp, the publisher clock and use_sim_time, including time-source consistency and synchronization.

description.zh: 指令时间戳异常
description.en: Command timestamps are missing, reversed, stale or in the future.

troubleshooting.zh: 核对指令header.stamp和example时钟，检查use_sim_time与硬件端时间源是否一致。
troubleshooting.en: Check command header.stamp and the example clock, and verify that use_sim_time and hardware time sources agree.

description.zh: CAN 错误帧
description.en: The CAN interface reported a receive error frame.

troubleshooting.zh: 按source定位CAN总线，查看硬件错误日志并检查供电、终端电阻、接线与波特率；该事件无明确恢复证据时锁存。
troubleshooting.en: Locate the CAN bus using source, inspect hardware logs and check power, termination, wiring and bitrate; this event stays latched without explicit recovery evidence.

description.zh: CAN 发送接口返回失败
description.en: The CAN transmit interface returned a failure.

troubleshooting.zh: 查看对应CAN发送失败日志，检查PCI连接、总线负载及电机连接；不要只凭后续无报错判断恢复。
troubleshooting.en: Inspect the relevant CAN transmit failure and check PCI connectivity, bus load and motor connections; silence alone is not evidence of recovery.

description.zh: 用户 CAN 接收队列发生丢包
description.en: The user-space CAN receive queue dropped packets.

troubleshooting.zh: 查看接收丢包计数与系统负载，检查消费阻塞和总线数据量；不通过放宽保护阈值处理。
troubleshooting.en: Inspect receive-drop counters and system load, checking for blocked consumers and excessive bus traffic; do not relax protection thresholds.

description.zh: 用户 CAN 发送队列发生丢包
description.en: The user-space CAN transmit queue dropped packets.

troubleshooting.zh: 查看发送丢包计数和系统负载，检查发送阻塞及命令产生速率。
troubleshooting.en: Inspect transmit-drop counters and system load, checking for blocked transmission and excessive command production.

description.zh: 串口打开失败
description.en: The IMU serial port could not be opened.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查/dev/ttyIMU是否存在、设备连接与串口访问权限，并查看原始打开错误。
troubleshooting.en: Check that /dev/ttyIMU exists, verify the connection and serial-port permissions, and inspect the original open error.

description.zh: 串口读取失败
description.en: An IMU serial read failed.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查串口连接与原始read/poll错误，核对设备是否断开或被其他进程占用。
troubleshooting.en: Check the serial connection and original read/poll error, including disconnection or another process using the device.

description.zh: 帧解析失败
description.en: An IMU data frame could not be parsed.

troubleshooting.zh: 核对IMU协议、串口921600配置和连接质量，查看原始帧解析错误。
troubleshooting.en: Verify the IMU protocol, the 921600 serial configuration and connection quality, then inspect frame-parsing errors.

description.zh: IMU 数据中断
description.en: The required IMU data stream has stopped.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查imu_data发布端、频率和QoS；禁用硬件内置IMU读取时仍需外部节点提供example所需数据。
troubleshooting.en: Check the imu_data publisher, rate and QoS; disabling the built-in reader still requires an external publisher when example needs IMU data.

description.zh: 非有限数或四元数范数异常
description.en: IMU values are non-finite or the quaternion norm is invalid.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查四元数、角速度和加速度中的NaN/Inf及四元数范数，核对驱动输出。
troubleshooting.en: Check quaternion, angular velocity and acceleration for NaN/Inf and verify the quaternion norm against the driver output.

description.zh: example 的 IMU 超时保护已锁存
description.en: The existing example IMU timeout protection is latched.

troubleshooting.zh: 先检查IMU数据恢复及时间戳，再查看example保护日志；数据恢复不等于保护锁存已解除。
troubleshooting.en: First verify that IMU data and timestamps have recovered, then inspect example protection logs; resumed data does not itself clear the latch.

description.zh: IMU 时间戳异常
description.en: IMU timestamps are missing, reversed, stale or in the future.

troubleshooting.zh: 核对imu_data.header.stamp、时钟同步和use_sim_time，避免混用系统时间与仿真时间。
troubleshooting.en: Check imu_data.header.stamp, clock synchronization and use_sim_time; do not mix system and simulation clocks.

description.zh: 遥控器就绪心跳中断
description.en: The input-device readiness heartbeat has stopped.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查遥控器管理节点及input_ready心跳；motion_commands按变化发布，不能用其静默判断断连。
troubleshooting.en: Check the input-device manager and input_ready heartbeat; motion_commands is change-driven, so silence there does not establish disconnection.

description.zh: InputDeviceManager 没有就绪的输入设备
description.en: InputDeviceManager has no ready input device.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查遥控器连接和输入设备管理日志；心跳存在但data=false表示设备未就绪。
troubleshooting.en: Check the controller connection and input-device manager logs; a heartbeat with data=false means the device is not ready.

description.zh: 遥控速度、高度或角速度含非有限数
description.en: Remote motion commands contain non-finite values.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查motion_commands的速度、角速度和高度是否为NaN/Inf，定位对应输入映射。
troubleshooting.en: Check motion_commands velocity, yaw rate and height for NaN/Inf and inspect the corresponding input mapping.

description.zh: 启用相机检查后未收到任何随帧元数据
description.en: No camera frame metadata was received while camera checks were enabled.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查相机节点、连接和CameraInfo话题；若主动关闭全部相机，应关闭check_camera。
troubleshooting.en: Check camera nodes, connections and CameraInfo topics; disable check_camera when all cameras are intentionally disabled.

description.zh: 已发现的某个相机流中断
description.en: A previously discovered camera metadata stream has stopped.

troubleshooting.zh: 按source定位具体CameraInfo流，检查对应发布端、频率和驱动日志；不表示已检查图像像素内容。
troubleshooting.en: Locate the CameraInfo stream using source and check its publisher, rate and driver logs; this does not imply image-pixel validation.

description.zh: 帧尺寸或标定元数据异常
description.en: Camera frame dimensions or calibration metadata are invalid.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查source流的width/height及K、D标定数值，核对分辨率与驱动配置。
troubleshooting.en: Check the source stream's width/height and K/D calibration values against resolution and driver configuration.

description.zh: 已启用的电池话题中断
description.en: The enabled battery-state stream has stopped.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查battery_states发布端和连接；仅在check_battery启用时检查，若改过battery_topic应使用实际名称。
troubleshooting.en: Check the battery_states publisher and connection; this check requires check_battery, and a changed battery_topic must be used.

description.zh: 电压、电流或 SOC 无效
description.en: Battery voltage, current or state of charge is invalid.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查voltage/current/soc是否有限、voltage是否大于0以及soc是否为0至100；不新增高低电压阈值。
troubleshooting.en: Check finite voltage/current/soc values, voltage greater than zero and soc within 0 to 100; no additional voltage thresholds are defined.

description.zh: example 状态心跳中断
description.en: The example runtime status heartbeat has stopped.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查example进程和state_machine_info话题，核对运行入口是否提供该状态。
troubleshooting.en: Check the example process and state_machine_info topic, and verify that the selected entry point publishes runtime status.

description.zh: 状态 JSON 或必需字段无效
description.en: Example status JSON or required fields are invalid.

troubleshooting.zh: 查看robot_diagnose的解析错误与state_machine_info内容，核对control_timing.total_cycles等必需字段。
troubleshooting.en: Inspect robot_diagnose parsing errors and state_machine_info, including required fields such as control_timing.total_cycles.

description.zh: 控制线程、推理或 executor 异常
description.en: The control thread, inference runtime or executor failed.

troubleshooting.zh: 先确保机械安全，查看example最早的fatal_error及异常堆栈，核对模型、输入和运行资源。
troubleshooting.en: Secure the mechanism first, then inspect the first example fatal_error and traceback, including model, inputs and runtime resources.

description.zh: 心跳仍在，但控制周期计数超过 1 秒不再推进
description.en: Runtime status continues but the control cycle counter stopped for over one second.

troubleshooting.zh: 检查control_timing.total_cycles是否推进，结合线程状态与日志排查阻塞或推理停滞。
troubleshooting.en: Check whether control_timing.total_cycles advances, then use thread state and logs to investigate blocking or stalled inference.

description.zh: 配置、模型或 runtime 初始化异常
description.en: Example configuration, model or runtime initialization failed.

troubleshooting.zh: 查看example启动时首个异常，核对配置与模型路径、格式和依赖，不反复启动电机试错。
troubleshooting.en: Inspect the first example startup exception and verify configuration and model paths, formats and dependencies; do not repeatedly start motors to diagnose it.

description.zh: 复位响应失败或 Future 异常
description.en: A reset response failed or its future raised an exception.

troubleshooting.zh: 查看example复位响应和异常日志，检查robot_reset服务是否存在；未查清原因前不要反复调用复位。
troubleshooting.en: Inspect the example reset response and exception logs, and check that robot_reset exists; do not repeatedly reset before resolving the cause.

description.zh: 后台 maintenance 异常
description.en: The example background maintenance task reported an error.

troubleshooting.zh: 查看runtime中的maintenance_error及后台任务日志，定位失败的维护步骤。
troubleshooting.en: Inspect maintenance_error in runtime status and background-task logs to identify the failing maintenance step.

description.zh: 旧 walk 入口触发其原有 60° 姿态保护
description.en: The existing walk entry point triggered its 60-degree attitude protection.

troubleshooting.zh: 先确保机械安全，核对IMU姿态、安装方向和walk日志；不通过调大角度阈值掩盖异常。
troubleshooting.en: Secure the mechanism first, then check IMU attitude, mounting orientation and walk logs; do not raise the angle threshold to hide the fault.

description.zh: Mod 不可用或加载失败
description.en: A Mod is unavailable or failed to load.

troubleshooting.zh: 按source的Mod id查看snapshot中的error，核对对应配置、依赖和模型资源。
troubleshooting.en: Use the Mod id in source to inspect its snapshot error, then check configuration, dependencies and model resources.

description.zh: Mod 报告警告
description.en: A Mod reported a warning.

troubleshooting.zh: 查看对应Mod的warnings原文，根据其实际内容排查，不把警告自动当成致命错误。
troubleshooting.en: Read the Mod's original warnings and investigate their actual content; do not automatically treat warnings as fatal errors.

description.zh: 当前准备进入状态的必需资源加载失败
description.en: A required resource for the state being prepared failed to load.

troubleshooting.zh: 按source的资源id查看preparing.resources中的失败原因，核对模型文件、权限及后端依赖。
troubleshooting.en: Use the resource id in source to inspect preparing.resources, then check model files, permissions and backend dependencies.

description.zh: Mod 子节点不可用或故障
description.en: A Mod child node is unavailable or faulted.

troubleshooting.zh: 按source的子节点id查看runtime中的error、退出状态和子进程日志。
troubleshooting.en: Use the child-node id in source to inspect its runtime error, exit status and subprocess logs.

description.zh: Mod 子进程正在重启
description.en: A Mod subprocess is restarting.

troubleshooting.zh: 查看子进程重启次数、退出原因及日志；持续重启时排查根因而非仅等待恢复。
troubleshooting.en: Inspect subprocess restart counts, exit reasons and logs; repeated restarts require investigation of the underlying cause.

description.zh: 控制计算超预算计数增加
description.en: The control computation budget-overrun counter increased.

troubleshooting.zh: 查看control_timing新增超预算计数，结合CPU、推理耗时与后台负载分析；历史累计值本身不代表当前故障。
troubleshooting.en: Inspect new control_timing budget overruns against CPU load, inference duration and background work; historical totals alone are not a current fault.

description.zh: 控制截止时间错过计数增加
description.en: The control deadline-miss counter increased.

troubleshooting.zh: 查看control_timing新增miss和执行耗时，检查调度竞争、CPU负载及阻塞调用。
troubleshooting.en: Inspect new control_timing deadline misses and execution time, checking scheduler contention, CPU load and blocking calls.

description.zh: 控制周期跳过计数增加
description.en: The skipped-control-period counter increased.

troubleshooting.zh: 查看control_timing新增跳周期计数与系统负载，排查执行超时及调度延迟，不直接降低控制频率。
troubleshooting.en: Inspect new skipped periods and system load for execution overruns and scheduling delays; do not directly reduce the control frequency.
